dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Highly concave (falcate) trailing edge exhibiting a non-uniform spline characterized by three primary notches: a shallow nick near the apex, a larger triangular excision mid-edge, and a jagged lower-tier indentation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a medium pixel radius; lacks sharp terminal point due to apparent abrasion or morphological rounding.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 70-degree incline relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of maximum vertical height to maximum visible base width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple traumatic notches on the trailing edge. Numerous small, circular white lesions or depigmentation spots (punctate markings) are distributed across the lateral surface of the fin and dorsal body.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive distribution of high-contrast white spotting against a dark epidermal background, particularly concentrated along the dorsal ridge and lateral fin surface.
